notes.title: Atom Zombie August Update
notes.notes:
Hello all, here's the update for August 2023:

[h1]Hotkeys[/h1]
We've added new hotkeys to streamline the zombie smashing experience.

[list]
[*][b]Left/right bracket:[/b] will select next/previous unit.
[*][b]Home/end:[/b] will fully zoom in or fully zoom out.
[/list]
[h1]Mods[/h1]
The online mod fileshare download now works again -- you can now browse user-submitted mods, download them, and play them.

[h1]Legacy stuff[/h1]
Disabled some ancient stuff that had broken down over time: the report-a-bug, mod uploading, and the newsletter functionality.

Additionally, the new hotkeys should make the game more playable on the Steam Deck. Enjoy!

notes.title: Quadrilateral Cowboy release date
notes.notes:
I'm very excited to announce Quadrilateral Cowboy will be released on July 25, 2016 at 10AM PST.

Quadrilateral Cowboy is a first-person cyberpunk heist adventure from Blendo Games, developer of titles such as Atom Zombie Smasher and Thirty Flights of Loving.

The initial launch will be for Windows, with the Mac and Linux builds coming in September 2016. Read more info at: http://blendogames.com/qc 

See you in a week!
